_comment: Shared vectors for rayd_core::secret_gateway::route::path_is_safe (m15-secrets-gateway and sec-rayd-agent-hardening, T24 confused-deputy mitigation). Every 'unsafe' path must be refused (403 not_allowed) even under a matching wildcard rule, and refused as an allow-rule path by rayd (empty_path for the first two, invalid_allow_path for the rest) and by both SDKs (InvalidArgumentException/InvalidArgumentError); every 'safe' one must reach the allowlist check and be accepted as an allow-rule path. The rule is an allowlist: each segment holds only RFC 3986 unreserved characters, ':' '@' and the sub-delims except ';', plus well-formed percent-encoded bytes; decoded exactly once, a segment must be valid UTF-8 with no control byte, no '/', '\\', '%' or ';', and must not be '.' or '..'.
